offers.title: Sealed Air Cryovac Dri-Loc
offers.desc: Market leader global. Dri-Loc paling dipakai retail daging sapi/ayam. SAP ultra, PE perforated, food-grade FDA/EU. Kapasitas tertinggi, distribusi worldwide termasuk Indonesia via distributor.

offers.title: Novipax SuperAbsorb
offers.desc: Leader USA, supply Walmart/Costco. Airlaid + SAP, anti-leak seal, varian black pad untuk daging merah. Kapasitas jumbo untuk tray besar.

offers.title: Sirane Dri-Fresh Fresh-Hold
offers.desc: Leader Eropa. Dri-Fresh range lengkap: standard, super, absorbent + anti-fog. Sertifikasi BRC, supply Tesco/M&S. Ada versi compostable.

offers.title: McAirlaid's OptiDri
offers.desc: Jerman, teknologi airlaid non-woven proprietary. Dry-Means tidak pakai fluff pulp — lebih tipis tapi serap tinggi. OEKO-TEX, supply Lidl/Aldi.

offers.title: Elliott Absorbents Meat Pad
offers.desc: UK leader, 40+ tahun. Range paling luas: mini 60x80mm sampai jumbo 200x300mm. PE backing anti-bocor, food contact approved.

offers.title: PaperPak Absorbent Pads
offers.desc: Leader Kanada, fokus sustainable. 100% recycled cellulose + SAP food-grade. Supply Sobeys, Costco Canada. Harga kompetitif untuk volume besar.

offers.title: Cellcomb Absorber Pad
offers.desc: Challenger Skandinavia. Serang leader dengan harga 15-20% lebih murah, kualitas setara. Supply ICA, Coop. Varian anti-bakteri.

offers.title: Coating Excellence Thermasorb
offers.desc: Challenger USA. Thermasorb dengan heat-seal edge — tidak bocor samping. Target ambil share Novipax di midwest USA.

offers.title: De Cymbal Absorbent Soaker
offers.desc: Challenger UK harga fighter. Fluff pulp + SAP, PE backing. Fokus pasar wholesale & butcher lokal, MOQ rendah.

offers.title: Mascarello Soaker Pad
offers.desc: Challenger Italia. Desain tipis untuk packaging premium (prosciutto, bresaola). Supply pasar Mediterania, ekspansi ke Asia.

offers.title: Qingdao Ideal Goal Pad
offers.desc: Challenger China terbesar. Harga 40-50% di bawah leader, kapasitas setara. Supply OEM untuk brand Eropa. MOQ 50k pcs, lead time 20 hari.

offers.title: Zhongshan Qidong Soaker
offers.desc: Challenger China, spesialis export. Varian warna hitam/putih, ukuran custom. Sudah masuk pasar Indonesia via importir Jakarta.

offers.title: Dewi Pack Soaker Lokal
offers.desc: Follower lokal Indonesia. Produksi Bandung/Surabaya, tissue + SAP impor, PE lokal. Harga murah, kualitas menengah. Jual via Shopee/Tokopedia, MOQ 1k pcs.

offers.title: Indo Absorb Standard
offers.desc: Follower lokal, tanpa SAP (hanya cellulose). Daya serap rendah, cocok untuk ayam potong & ikan segar. Harga paling murah, target pasar tradisional.

offers.title: Bulteau Soaker Basic
offers.desc: Follower Prancis. Ikut spec leader tapi tanpa inovasi. Harga mid, supply pasar lokal Perancis & export kecil.

offers.title: Tristar Packaging Pad
offers.desc: Follower India. Fluff pulp lokal, PE impor. Fokus pasar domestik India & export ke Timur Tengah. Harga low-end.

offers.title: Viet Pack Absorbent
offers.desc: Follower Vietnam. Copy desain China, harga sedikit lebih tinggi tapi kualitas kontrol lebih baik. Supply pasar ASEAN.

offers.title: Generic Alibaba Soaker 100pcs
offers.desc: Follower generic Alibaba. Banyak seller, kualitas bervariasi. Risiko: tidak semua food-grade certified. Wajib minta COA & migration test sebelum bulk.

offers.title: Sirane Earth Packaging Compostable
offers.desc: Nicher eco. 100% compostable, plastic-free, EN13432 certified. Target premium organic meat, zero-waste retailer. Harga 30-40% premium.

offers.title: Sealed Air rDri-Loc Recycle-Ready
offers.desc: Nicher sustainable. Recycle-ready pad, bisa masuk stream PE recycling. Jawab demand retailer ESG (Aldi, Carrefour).

offers.title: Cryovac Active CO2 Emitter Pad
offers.desc: Nicher active packaging. Pad + CO2 emitter extend shelf life 2-3 hari. Untuk daging premium export, seafood. Butuh cold chain ketat.

offers.title: Sirane Dri-Fresh ABV Antimicrobial
offers.desc: Nicher antimicrobial. Infused active agent hambat bakteri, kurangi bau drip. Untuk ayam & ikan yang cepat busuk. BRC + EFSA approved.

offers.title: PaperPak Ultra Green Bio
offers.desc: Nicher bio. SAP dari pati tanaman (bukan akrilik), kraft paper unbleached. Target pasar organic/natural meat USA & EU.

offers.title: TOMI Odor-Capture Pad
offers.desc: Nicher Jepang. Pad + activated charcoal serap bau amis. Untuk ikan sashimi-grade & daging wagyu. Pasar premium Jepang/Korea.

offers.title: McAirlaid's Black Pad Premium
offers.desc: Nicher visual. Pad hitam untuk daging merah — drip tidak terlihat, display lebih menarik. Dipakai premium butcher & steakhouse.

offers.title: Cellcomb Freshness Indicator
offers.desc: Nicher smart. Pad + indikator warna pH: berubah jika daging mulai rusak. Untuk supply chain farm-to-retail, kurangi food waste.
